notice: Candidate mass-ending events. Nothing here is a finding until the cited primary source is held through research/readiness/FETCH_QUEUE.jsonl and the source-ladder job, and the verification phrases are found in its text. Even then an event is a candidate end for an order: the order's own scope, an earlier end and savings must still be checked by an agent. The 'what_to_verify' lines are questions written by Claude on 2026-10-19 from the plan, not facts.

events.name: Joint resolution of March 3, 1921 (ch. 136): certain war Acts, joint resolutions and proclamations construed as though the war had ended

verify_phrases: as if the war had ended and the present or existing emergency expired

what_to_verify: Which Acts and proclamations the resolution names; an order made under a statute it does not name is not reached.
The resolution's exceptions (the Trading with the Enemy Act is reported to be excepted, so Alien Property Custodian orders are not mapped).
Whether the order ended earlier on its own terms (armistice, completion, revocation).

events.name: End of the NRA codes: Schechter (May 27, 1935) and the expiry of NIRA Title I

verify_phrases: code-making authority thus conferred is an unconstitutional delegation of legislative power
delegating power to the President to approve or prescribe codes of fair competition and providing for the enforcement of such codes are hereby repealed

what_to_verify: Schechter held the code-making delegation invalid; whether that ends an approval order on May 27, 1935, or the statutory expiry ends it, is an agent's judgment per order.
The text and date of NIRA section 2(c) expiry and of the June 14, 1935 joint resolution (49 Stat. 375).
Orders that are not code approvals (labor boards, agreements, administrative orders) need their own basis.

events.name: End of the Canal Zone government (Panama Canal Treaty in force October 1, 1979; Panama Canal Act of 1979)
what_to_verify: Many Canal Zone orders ended earlier: superseded by later orders, by the Canal Zone Code, or on their own terms.
Which functions the 1979 Act continued (the Panama Canal Commission), which would be savings, not an end.

events.name: Philippine independence, July 4, 1946 (Tydings-McDuffie Act of 1934; Proclamation 2695)
what_to_verify: Military and naval reservations retained under the 1947 bases agreement did not end on independence.
Philippine civil-service and administrative orders may have ended with the 1935 Commonwealth.

events.name: Federal Land Policy and Management Act, October 21, 1976: repeal of implied and listed withdrawal authority
what_to_verify: FLPMA repealed the authority to make new withdrawals; existing withdrawals are reported to continue until revoked (savings in section 701, review in section 204(l)). It is mapped so that agents look for a later Public Land Order revocation (X2), never as an end by itself.
